skill.name: knowledge-work-operations
skill.description: Use when running business-operations work — vendor management, process documentation, change management, capacity planning, and compliance tracking — standalone or connected to your ITSM and tracker.
whenToUse: Evaluating a vendor — cost analysis, risk assessment, contract summary, renewal call
Documenting a business process with flowcharts, RACI matrices, SOPs, and runbooks
Creating a change request with impact analysis, rollback plan, and approval routing
Planning resource capacity — workload analysis, headcount modeling, utilization forecasting

keyConcepts.explanation: Commands are explicit slash workflows (/vendor-review, /process-doc, /change-request, /capacity-plan, /status-report, /runbook); skills are domain knowledge Claude applies automatically.
Evaluates, compares, and manages vendor relationships across contracts, performance, and risk, backing the /vendor-review command.
Analyzes and improves business processes — identifying bottlenecks, reducing waste, and streamlining workflows.
Plans and executes organizational or technical changes with communication, training, and adoption, behind /change-request.
risk-assessment builds risk registers and impact analysis with controls; compliance-tracking tracks audits, certifications, and regulatory deadlines.
Plans and optimizes resource allocation — capacity, utilization, forecasting, and budget — backing the /capacity-plan command.

gotchas: Primarily designed for Cowork, Anthropic's agentic desktop app, though it also works in Claude Code
Commands run standalone but are supercharged only when you connect your ITSM, project tracker, and other tools
It's a plugin bundling nine skills, not a single skill; skills fire automatically while commands are invoked explicitly
/vendor-review needs the vendor name, contract details, or an uploaded proposal to produce a real evaluation
Compliance-tracking outputs are working aids, not a substitute for a qualified auditor or legal review
